nodes.description: Public string state variable storing the token symbol 'TKR'.
Public string state variable storing the token name 'Bit-TKR'.
Public uint8 state variable storing token decimals (18).
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply.
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances per account.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of allowances.
Constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, total supply and assigns all tokens to the owner address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to' using and decrementing the caller's allowance.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract (external call).
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting ETH.
Pure addition with overflow check require(c >= a).
Pure subtraction with underflow check require(b <= a).
Pure multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure division with require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and callback argument.
Arithmetic operation c = a + b in safeAdd (pre-0.8 unchecked overflow, guarded by require).
Arithmetic operation c = a - b in safeSub (pre-0.8 unchecked underflow, guarded by require).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) transferring control to an arbitrary user-supplied contract.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes _totalSupply.
Constructor writes the initial owner balance into balances.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom() reads and writes the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer uses msg.sender as the balance debit account.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and as callback argument.
msg.sender is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call, coupling untrusted input with an external control transfer.
transfer() invokes safeAdd when crediting the destination balance.
transfer() invokes safeSub when debiting the sender balance.
transferFrom() invokes safeAdd when crediting the destination balance.
transferFrom() invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
safeAdd performs the unchecked pre-0.8 addition a + b.
safeSub performs the unchecked pre-0.8 subtraction a - b.
approveAndCall() executes an external call to the spender-controlled contract.
The callee of receiveApproval can re-enter transferFrom() and consume the freshly granted allowance.
